label: REFERS_TO_1: N.RefersTo n b: in the practice's use, the name n REFERS_TO_1 the being b
term: refers to (a name, in a practice's use)
definition: `N.RefersTo n b`: in the practice's use, the name n refers to (applies to) the being b. The practice-use sense of a name's application, as minimalists speak of reference inside a language game; not the proper sense fixed by a nominal definition (DEF-GOD-NOMINAL-Q13).
note: Typed reference relation for #1010 (owner request 2026-11-05). It fixes no theory of reference; DISAMB-NAME-APPLICATION says how it relates to the leaves' proper-sense predicate.

formal_gap.meaning: NamingPractice.RefersTo n b says that, in the practice's use, the name n refers to (applies to) the being b: the practice-use sense of a name's application, as minimalists speak of reference inside a language game. It is a supplied relation between names and beings and fixes no theory of reference.
examples: In ordinary English use the name 'Socrates' refers to Socrates.
exclusions: The proper sense of a name fixed by its nominal definition (DEF-GOD-NOMINAL-Q13): DISAMB-NAME-APPLICATION keeps the two senses apart; the link theorems use the practice-use relation for the leaves only as a schema, under an identification no record asserts.
A move's confessing that a name names a being (ConfessesReferent): a property of content, not reference.
open_obligations: The identification of practice-use reference with the proper sense is open and asserted nowhere.
STMT-GRAMMAR-FIXES-REFERENCE and STMT-GOD-NAMES-NO-BEING-WF-P1 constrain it as open premises.
No formalization candidate: reference in use is taken as primitive.
